## E — Market signal: special driving conditions (night, weather, emergencies, floods, work zones and stopped emergency vehicles)
Market research was not performed in this state worker pass and no CompetitiveIntel artifact was supplied, so the market pack for this topic is typed debt (NV-SPEC-MARKET).
Open items: applicant volume, pass rates, seasonality, buyer persona, price expectations, verbatim voice-of-customer quotes, ad hooks and the named gap.
Handbook-only observation, not market evidence: emergency procedures such as brake failure, a stuck pedal and blowouts are easy to mix up, which suggests a what-do-you-do-first drill angle to test later.
No market figures are asserted; every figure waits for a sourced recon pass.
